'''Brain-Barrel''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] serving the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Stationed at [[Eyrie Base]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], it accompanied [[Stevan Makintay]] and [[Merinda Niemeh]] during their mission to [[Hargeeva]].
